== bad version
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== type 0xd0
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== handshake ok
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, 'H', 0, 'OK')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 1, 12)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': 0, 'A': None}
== long reserved bits
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== short reserved bits
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== short fixed bit 0
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== dcid len 21
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== length < pn width
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]

   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== truncated short header
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== empty wire
   pkts []
   dgs [(1, 0, 0, 0)]
   closed None recv {'I': None, 'H': None, 'A': None}
== bad then good
   pkts [(1, 0, 0, None, None, 'BAD_HEADER'), (2, 0, 0, 'I', 0, 'OK')]
   dgs [(1, 1, 0, 0), (2, 1, 1, 13)]
   closed None recv {'I': 0, 'H': None, 'A': None}

   pkts [(1, 0, 0, 'A', 0, 'AUTH')]
